verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a natural-language coding agent. Its docs show plain-English prompts for understanding code ("Explain this repo", "Walk me through this file") and for troubleshooting-adjacent work: a recurring check that reports test-suite failures, and background monitors that watch logs or CI and flag errors. No documentation describes a dedicated workflow for diagnosing and fixing bugs. missing for 10: explicit debugging/root-cause-analysis and fix workflow documentation, examples of interpreting stack traces or errors, independent hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: /loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors
The TUI provides a rich, mouse-interactive, fullscreen experience for coding with agents.
